general.description:
The Ring system and planetary colony are named, not from a feature of the planet itself or a nearby orbital body in the system, but after a feature of the hyperspace links around it, which form a ring af several systems.
The planet is a lively world with diverse ecosystems ranging from deserts to ice caps, with the most of the lands covered with verdant forests.
general.bar: A crowd of diverse merchantbeings from all species and cultures
